title: One-Bowl Chocolate Cake
description: A dark, moist chocolate sheet cake mixed in one bowl, with a glossy chocolate frosting. Reliable for birthdays and bake sales.
scaleNote: One batch fills a {len 9x13 in} pan, or two {len 8 in} rounds baked 30 to 35 minutes.

image.alt: A chocolate layer cake with a slice cut showing the layers

items.item: hot brewed coffee or hot water

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 350F oven}. Grease the pan and line the bottom with parchment.
Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a large bowl. Add the eggs, buttermilk, oil and vanilla and whisk until smooth.
Whisk in the hot coffee; the batter will be thin. That’s what makes the cake so moist. Pour into the pan.
Bake until a toothpick in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs, {time 32-36 min}. Cool completely in the pan, about {time 1 hr notimer}.
Beat the butter and cocoa until smooth, then beat in the powdered sugar, milk and vanilla until fluffy. Spread over the cooled cake.

notes: The coffee deepens the chocolate flavor without tasting of coffee. Hot water works too.
